subject.title: Discord leaks internal tool-call traces (NO_REPLY, commentary, to=functions) to channel

question: Should the remaining Discord envelope sanitizer live at the shared outbound delivery boundary, a Discord-only boundary, or the broader cross-channel final-delivery policy tracked by the related leak cluster?
rationale: The remaining leak is security-sensitive, but the sanitizer can also remove valid user-visible Discord content if the boundary is too broad.

options.title: Narrow shared outbound guard
options.body: Add a shared final-delivery guard for proven internal envelope/control traces and require Discord plus shared outbound regression tests.

options.title: Discord-only tactical guard
options.body: Patch the Discord outbound paths first while leaving the broader cross-channel policy to a separate issue.

options.title: Defer to broader leak policy
options.body: Keep this issue dependent on the broader inter-tool leakage work and avoid a Discord-specific patch until that policy is approved.

recommendation.title: Narrow shared outbound guard
recommendation.body: Add a shared final-delivery guard for proven internal envelope/control traces and require Discord plus shared outbound regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared outbound and Discord delivery boundary files route through this recent area work.
